claude.rationale: The Contribution Agreement was mutually terminated on December 21, 2018 before the scheduled stockholder vote, and the slice states "no consideration was paid and no interests were contributed or acquired." Because nothing crossed the ownership boundary at closing (there was no closing), no customer-facing asset (T4) transferred apart from its processes, so gap_45 is 0; likewise no processes (T5) transferred apart from the organization (T6), so gap_56 is 0. All tiers are coded terminate to reflect the deal structure's mutual termination, and there is no documented gap to mitigate (NA).

grok.rationale: The Contribution Agreement was mutually terminated on December 21, 2018 before the stockholder vote and before any closing; the slice states no consideration was paid and no interests were contributed or acquired. Because neither the customer-facing Midland Basin reserves/wellbore assets (T4) nor any operational processes (T5) crossed the ownership boundary, gap_45 is 0. Likewise neither processes (T5) nor organization/people (T6) transferred, so gap_56 is 0; gap_mitigated is therefore NA.
